parameters.query:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(occurrence_count), 0) as total_occurrences,
    COALESCE(BOOL_OR(is_blocked), false) as has_been_blocked,
    COALESCE(MAX(recent_count) FILTER (WHERE pattern_type = 'SSH Failed Password'), 0) as ssh_attempts,
    COALESCE(MAX(recent_count) FILTER (WHERE pattern_type = 'Root Login Attempt'), 0) as root_attempts,
    COALESCE(MAX(recent_count) FILTER (WHERE pattern_type = 'Port Scan'), 0) as port_scan_count,
    COALESCE(MAX(recent_count) FILTER (WHERE pattern_type = 'Access Denied'), 0) as access_denied_count,
    COALESCE(MAX(recent_count) FILTER (WHERE pattern_type = 'Iptables Drop'), 0) as iptables_drop_count,
    COALESCE(MAX(recent_count) FILTER (WHERE pattern_type = 'Sudo Usage'), 0) as sudo_usage_count
FROM attack_patterns 
WHERE source_ip = '{{ $json.source_ip }}';

nodes.name: Obtener informacion de la reputacion de la IP

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO attack_patterns (pattern_type, source_ip, target_host, first_seen, last_seen, occurrence_count, recent_count, window_start, is_blocked)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.rule_name }}',
  '{{ $json.source_ip }}',
  '{{ $json.target_host }}',
  NOW(), NOW(), 1, 1, NOW(),
  {{ $json.risk_level === 'CRITICAL' || $json.risk_level === 'HIGH' }}
)
ON CONFLICT (source_ip, pattern_type) DO UPDATE SET
  last_seen = NOW(),
  occurrence_count = attack_patterns.occurrence_count + 1,
  recent_count = CASE 
    WHEN NOW() - attack_patterns.window_start > INTERVAL '1 hour' 
    THEN 1
    ELSE attack_patterns.recent_count + 1
  END,
  window_start = CASE
    WHEN NOW() - attack_patterns.window_start > INTERVAL '1 hour'
    THEN NOW()
    ELSE attack_patterns.window_start
  END,
  is_blocked = attack_patterns.is_blocked OR EXCLUDED.is_blocked;
